text: {"overall_winner":"A","qualities":[{"evidence":"clear opening, body paragraphs, and closing","quality":"organization","description":"The essay is arranged into a recognizable introduction, supporting body, and conclusion that help develop the argument coherently."},{"evidence":"“First, the article explains all the pros… Next, I believe… Also… Many people have reason to believe…”","quality":"development","description":"The essay develops its position with multiple reasons and paragraphs rather than brief, scattered thoughts."},{"evidence":"mentions fuel efficiency, safety alerts, construction, and liability concerns","quality":"use of source evidence","description":"The essay draws on several specific details from the article to support both its claims and its rebuttal."},{"evidence":"“Although this is a major concern, I believe that we can get past these concerns.”","quality":"counterargument handling","description":"The essay acknowledges opposing concerns and responds to them instead of only repeating one side."},{"evidence":"“So, these new smart cars, in my opinion, are pretty safe…”","quality":"clear stance","description":"The essay states a definite position on driverless cars and returns to it in the conclusion."}]}
